# What it is
The Report Builder creates a progress report for a batch or a single student.

# Creating a report
Open Reports, choose a batch, pick the subject and the date range, then press Build. The report shows lessons completed, quiz scores, project scores and time spent. Use Download to save it as a PDF.

# Notes
A student report is only visible to that student's teachers and school admins. Reports for other schools are never available.
